storyCards.fact:
Elton John's "Blue Eyes" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Blue Eyes" is a song performed by British musician Elton John with music and lyrics written by John and Gary Osborne.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Blue Eyes was released in 1996.
